classification: Published WP04 reconciliation delta lost while consuming exact Finance review-binding producer. Restore the union of already published implementations, not a new shared feature.

observed_failure.counterexample: H06 first apply intentionally loses response; same-proof retry succeeds with current state, consistent with stale post-commit CAS on first application.
observed_failure.qualification: The log prints HTTP status and transaction metrics, not the failure response body. The reconciliation reason and mechanism are derived from the exact source path, not claimed as a captured response.

source_verification: All three immutable owner/W1 producer blobs independently fetched through GitHub MCP; exact hashes agree with local materialized bytes.
causal_chain: createSfPreparedApply commits receipt and domain with additionalNamespaces cases, checking its current storage CAS.
createSfProductState increments every namespace named in scope, including cases, even though the first domain receipt transaction does not mutate the selected case value.

Finance apply.ts then reconciles with current.storageVersion captured before that increment. The transaction returns product-state-changed, mapped by createPreparedExecution to case-reconciliation-pending (HTTP503).

The preserved WP04 block reloads cases after the domain receipt, requires the entire case value to be unchanged, rereads and matches the authoritative receipt, rechecks case/application/current host authority, and uses the new reconciliation.storageVersion.
An actual concurrent case edit is distinguished by full case equality and returns stale/case-changed-after-application (HTTP409); it is never silently overwritten.
The write callback also preserves full selected-case digest equality under its lock.
preserved_finance_safety: Real reviewDigestFor callback and isReviewDigest validation
Digest mismatch/conflict handling and bound receipt replay
No changed permission, grant, target incarnation, CAS guard or command semantics

qualification.may_reuse_if_unchanged: prepared-apply/planner-apply/prepared-production component passes remain at their executed pin if they do not call createPreparedExecution; parent should apply the actual closure selection.
